objective: Create one manifest-owned plan-run branch and worktree without mutating the source or default branch
prefetch: Inspect git worktree list and the exact dirty baseline before mutation
Resolve the Git common directory and remote default branch in disposable repositories
Compare existing receipt fields and backward-compatibility tests
constraints: No stash, reset, clean, force checkout, force removal, or hidden checkpoint commit
Plan state stores intent while live path and owner state remains under the Git common directory
Internal integration ref must not resolve to a local or remote default branch
Current overlapping dirty kb-work and workflow-doc changes must be contained before execution
acceptance_criteria: One manifest maps idempotently to one visible plan-run branch and worktree
Dirty source state remains byte-identical and is not silently copied
Receipt records immutable base and explicit non-default integration ref and head
Unsafe owner, path, base, or release state fails closed
model_tier_reason: Git lifecycle around dirty user work and default-branch boundaries has high recovery and data-loss risk
escalation_triggers: Dirty source changes must be copied implicitly
The default branch becomes an internal target
Legacy receipts cannot be migrated safely
